src: ; 13 gradient_shader — the "hello world" of shaders: every thread colors one pixel
; A pixel (fragment) shader is a small program that runs once per pixel. On a
; GPU that means one thread per pixel: the whole image is one big grid launch.
; Here: a 32 x 32 image, one block per row, one thread per column.
; Watch for: zero divergence, perfectly coalesced stores, and the framebuffer
; panel in the visualizer filling row by row as blocks finish.
.block 32                      ; one thread per column (4 warps of 8)
.fb FB, W, H                   ; show this memory as an image
SUB  R4, R5, R4            ; blue = 255 - 4 * (x + y)
MAX  R4, R4, R6            ; clamp at 0
ADD  R7, R7, R1            ; + x = pixel index
ADD  R8, R8, R7            ; &fb[y * W + x]
